p: behind it: Meaning on the west side, as in Jos 8:9.
shall lie in wait against the: God would not destroy Ai by a miracle, as Jericho, so that other nations would fear the power and policy of his people.
among the people: With the rest of the army.
numbered the people: That is, viewed or mustered them and set them in array.
and set them to lie in: He sent these few, that the others who lay in ambush might not be discovered.
midst of the valley: To the intent that they in the city more easily discover his army.
made as if they were beaten: As they who pretended to flee for fear.
Stretch out the spear that is: Or, lift up the banner to signify when they should invade the city.
other issued out of the city: Who came out of the ambush.
smote it with the edge of: For the fire, which they had before set in the city, was not to consume it, but to signify to Joshua that they had entered.
ever: That it could never be built again.
that they should take his carcase: According as it was commanded, De 21:23.
copy of the law of Moses: Meaning, the ten commandments, which are the sum of the whole Law.
women: So neither young nor old, man nor woman, were exempted from hearing the word of the Lord.
